items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: This was before Chuck and Checkers came to New York, so how could he tell you about something he heard

ctx.x: There were kings in the Hoofers Club, like the Tip, Tap & Toe.

No, no -- Tip, Tap & Toe there -- no, no, no, no. This was before Chuck and Checkers came to New York, so how could he tell you about something he heard -- he only heard about this, but it wasn't what he thought it was. Now more than what you think they are now, same difference. He's far now from what he was. He ain't up to par for what he came here. However, this ain't a place where those kind of dancers -- they don't need to go to that club. You don't go there for that. You're finished dancing when you're out…
